# Accelint Appoints Brian Morrison as CEO

October 01, 2025

Accelint has announced the appointment of Brian Morrison as its new CEO, succeeding Mike Betzer, who led the company since its formation in 2024.

Accelint has announced the appointment of Brian Morrison as its new Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Mike Betzer. Betzer has been at the helm since 2024, when several companies, including Hypergiant and Forward Slope, merged to form Accelint, a key provider of AI and mission systems for the Department of Defense. Morrison brings extensive leadership experience from his previous roles at AeroVironment, BlueHalo, and General Dynamics, as well as his service in various governmental positions, including Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense.

Morrison's appointment was [announced in a press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/accelint-appoints-brian-morrison-as-chief-executive-officer-302572459.
html) , highlighting his commitment to advancing Accelint's mission of delivering AI-enabled solutions that enhance decision-making and resilience for the Department of Defense and commercial industries. His background includes significant achievements in both the public and private sectors, making him well-suited to lead Accelint into its next phase of growth.
